steps.title: Sermons — list, linked sermons, edit, player, delete
steps.goal: Under `/o/[orgSlug]/sermons` a leader with `sermons.link` lists sermons (members see published rows; any `sermons.*` holder also sees drafts and scheduled rows, with status/kind/search filters), creates a linked sermon on the Link tab of `/sermons/new` with a live `parseMediaLink` preview (YouTube nocookie iframe, Google Drive preview, Dropbox/other https native stream, or 'opens at provider'), edits title/speaker/preached_on/series/scripture_refs/description and the publish state (now, scheduled in the org timezone, or draft) on `/sermons/[id]`, plays any kind through `SermonPlayer` (uploaded media via a 1-hour signed URL re-minted on error, so 3.3b and 3.4a/3.4b reuse it), and deletes with `sermons.delete` (DB trigger queues the file, share links cascade). Upload tab is a disabled placeholder for 3.3b; the share-links card is a placeholder for 3.4a/3.4b. All reads/writes use the user client under RLS; the service client is not imported.

## Goal
When you finish, a church leader holding `sermons.link` can open `/o/<slug>/sermons`, see every published sermon (and drafts/scheduled sermons if they hold any `sermons.*` permission), open `/o/<slug>/sermons/new`, paste a YouTube, Dropbox, Google Drive or other https link on the **Link** tab, see a live preview produced by `parseMediaLink`, save it as a draft or publish it, then open `/o/<slug>/sermons/<id>` to edit title, speaker, preached-on date, series, scripture references, description and publish state, watch or listen through `SermonPlayer`, and — with `sermons.delete` — delete it. `SermonPlayer` already plays **uploaded** sermons too (1-hour signed URL, re-minted on error) so that step 3.3b only has to add the upload path and step 3.4a/3.4b can reuse the player on the public share page. The **Upload** tab exists as a disabled placeholder ("Uploads arrive in step 3.3b"). Every read goes through the user-scoped Supabase client under RLS; nothing in this step imports the service client.

## Inputs / prior state
- Step 3.1 built the org shell and guards. Reuse them exactly, never reshape them: `src/lib/auth/require-org.ts` (`requireOrgMember(slug)` → `OrgContext = { org: { org_id, slug, name, status }, membershipStatus, personId, householdId, permissions: PermissionKey[], isSuperAdmin, writable }` (2.1a contract — the org id field is `ctx.org.org_id`; confirm by reading `src/lib/auth/require-org.ts`), `requirePerm(ctx, perm | perms[])` (an array means any-of, delegating to `hasAnyPerm`), `requireWritable(ctx)` throwing `organization_suspended` when `!ctx.writable`, `isWritable(ctx)`), `src/features/org/nav.ts` (`NAV_ITEMS`), `src/features/org/org-context.tsx`, `StatusBanner`, `src/lib/storage/signed-url.ts` (`getSignedUrl(bucket, path, expiresIn)` on the user client — its return shape is not fixed by 3.1, so this step mints media URLs with 1.7a's `createSignedUrl` (below), which returns `{ url, expiresAt }`; use `getSignedUrl` only if it already returns that shape), `src/lib/actions/result.ts` (`ActionResult<T>`, `ok`, `fail`), `src/lib/supabase/errors.ts` (`toActionError`), `src/lib/env.ts` (`publicEnv()`, `serverEnv()`), `src/lib/supabase/{server,client}.ts` (`createServerSupabase()`, `createBrowserSupabase()`), the 2.1a Vitest harness (`vitest.config.ts`, `src/test/setup.ts` mocking `next/headers` and `next/navigation`), shadcn components in `src/components/ui/*`, and the settings query `getSettings(orgId)` (for `timezone`). Read `HANDOFF.md` "Deviations from plan" first — it records whether the guards use `forbidden()`/`notFound()` and the query module names 1.7a chose.
- Steps 1.6a/1.6b (`@church/domain`): `parseMediaLink(url, 'web' | 'mobile')` → `{ ok: true, kind, externalId?, canonicalUrl, embedUrl?, streamUrl?, strategy: 'youtube_hosted_embed' | 'native_stream' | 'webview' | 'open_external' } | { ok: false, reason: 'not_https' | 'invalid_url' | 'too_long' }`; `BUCKETS['sermon-media']` (`allowedMimeTypes`, `fileSizeLimitBytes`); `SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS` (3600), `SIGNED_URL_CACHE_MS`; `schemas/sermon.ts` — `sermonDetailsSchema` (`title` 1–200, `speaker`, `preached_on`, `series`, `scripture_refs` string[], `description` ≤ 4000, `publish_at` nullable datetime) and `sermonLinkSchema` (`external_url` https, refined with `parseMediaLink(url,'web').ok`); `errors.ts` (`toDomainError`, `errorMessageFor`, `DomainError`, `DOMAIN_ERROR_KEYS` — the 1.3b SQL catalogue plus `upload_too_large_for_plan`, `upload_mime_not_allowed`, `upload_object_exists`, `upload_failed`, `network`, `unknown`; there is NO `invalid_media_link` key — use `invalid_payload` with `field: 'external_url'`); `dates.ts` (`isValidTimeZone`, `todayInZone`, `ageInZone`, `bulletinPresets` — Intl-based helpers, NO instant formatters and NO datetime-local converters; this step writes those in `apps/web`, see Build 10). Do not write a `z.object` for sermons in `apps/web` — import these.
- Step 1.7a (`@church/db`): every query helper takes the client FIRST (`(db: DbClient, …args)`). `queries/sermons.ts` — `listSermons(db, orgId, { drafts, query, limit, offset })`, `getSermon(db, id)`, `insertSermonDraft(db, { id, org_id, title, …, media_kind, storage_path | external_url, external_id })` (the CALLER supplies `id`), `updateSermonAfterUpload(db, id, { mime_type, file_size_bytes, duration_seconds })`, `updateSermonDetails(db, id, patch)`, `publishSermon(db, id, publishAt | null)`, `deleteSermon(db, id)`; `queries/storage.ts` — `createSignedUrl(db, bucket, path, { ttl, download? })` → `{ url, expiresAt }`; `keys.ts` — `queryKeys.sermons.list(orgId, filters)`, `.sermons.detail(id)`. Read the real signatures in `packages/db/src/queries/sermons.ts` and `queries/storage.ts` before calling them; if one differs from this list, use the real one and note it in HANDOFF.
- Database (`supabase/migrations/9999_init.sql`, frozen if the HANDOFF ledger has a paste date — never edit it): `sermons` columns `id, org_id, title, speaker, preached_on, series, scripture_refs, description, media_kind (upload | youtube | dropbox | google_drive | url), storage_path, mime_type, file_size_bytes, duration_seconds, external_url, external_id, publish_at, created_by, updated_by`; checks `sermons_media_shape` (upload ⇒ `storage_path` set and `external_url` null; otherwise the reverse), `sermons_external_https` (`^https://`, ≤ 2048), `sermons_storage_path`. `publish_at null` = draft; `publish_at > now()` = scheduled. Policies (DESIGN §6): `ca_sermons_select_members` — members see `publish_at <= now()` rows, holders of any `sermons.*` permission see all rows of their org; `ca_sermons_insert_by_kind` — `media_kind = 'upload'` needs `sermons.upload`, every other kind needs `sermons.link`; update uses the same split; delete needs `sermons.delete`; every write also requires `app.org_writable(org_id)`. The delete trigger (`app.enqueue_storage_deletion`) queues the storage object into `storage_deletions`, `sermon_share_links` rows cascade, and `audit_log` records the delete. Storage: bucket `sermon-media`, private; `ca_storage_select` allows reading an object iff the sermon row is visible to the caller (`app.can_read_object`).
- Founder decisions that apply (HANDOFF "Founder answers"): decision 10 — Supabase Free, so `NEXT_PUBLIC_MAX_UPLOAD_MB` defaults to 50 and "link your own recording" is the lever for long recordings (surface that in the Link tab's helper text); decision 5 concerns share links and is step 3.4a/3.4b — do not build the share panel here, leave the slot.

## Build
1. **Navigation and routing.** In `src/features/org/nav.ts` add (or un-comment) `Sermons` → `/o/<slug>/sermons`, visible to every active member (members read published sermons). Create the route files under `apps/web/app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/sermons/`: `page.tsx` (list), `loading.tsx`, `error.tsx` (a `'use client'` error boundary with a "Try again" button calling `reset()` and the neutral text "Could not load sermons. If the church's Supabase project was paused, the founder must restore it from the dashboard."), `new/page.tsx`, `[id]/page.tsx`, `[id]/loading.tsx`, `[id]/not-found.tsx`. `params` and `searchParams` are Promises in Next 16 — `await` them. Every page starts with `const ctx = await requireOrgMember(orgSlug)`; write-capable UI is rendered only when `ctx.permissions` contains the relevant key, and every Server Action re-checks with `requirePerm` (UI gating is convenience, RLS + the guard are the security boundary).
2. **Permission helpers for this feature** in `src/features/sermons/perms.ts`: `canManageSermons(ctx)` = holds `sermons.upload` or `sermons.link` or `sermons.delete` (may see drafts, mirrors the select policy); `canEditSermon(ctx, sermon)` = `sermons.upload` when `media_kind === 'upload'`, else `sermons.link` (mirrors the update split); `canDeleteSermon(ctx)` = `sermons.delete`; `canCreateLink(ctx)` = `sermons.link`; `canCreateUpload(ctx)` = `sermons.upload`. Unit-test them with a table.
3. **List page** `/o/[orgSlug]/sermons` (`src/features/sermons/SermonsTable.tsx`, `SermonFilters.tsx`): read `searchParams` `status` (`published` default for members; `all` default for managers; also `drafts`, `scheduled`), `q` (title/speaker search), `kind` (`upload | youtube | dropbox | google_drive | url`), `page` (25 per page). Call `listSermons(db, ctx.org.org_id, …)` with the user client (`db = createServerSupabase()`); if the 1.7a signature lacks `kind`/`status` filters, filter the page in TypeScript and note it — do not change `@church/db` beyond an additive parameter. Columns: title (link to `/sermons/<id>`), speaker, preached on (formatted with this step's `src/features/sermons/dates.ts` — Build 10 — in the org `timezone` from `getSettings(db, ctx.org.org_id)`), a kind badge (Upload / YouTube / Dropbox / Google Drive / Link), status badge (Draft / Scheduled <local date-time> / Published), duration or file size when known. Header button "New sermon" when `canCreateLink(ctx) || canCreateUpload(ctx)`. Empty states: "No sermons yet" (+ the button when allowed); "Nothing matches these filters". Members never see the status filter (they can only see published rows anyway).
4. **New sermon page** `/o/[orgSlug]/sermons/new` with shadcn `Tabs` **Upload | Link** (`src/features/sermons/NewSermonTabs.tsx`). The Upload tab is rendered disabled with the text "Uploads arrive in step 3.3b — until then, link a recording hosted on YouTube (unlisted), Dropbox or Google Drive." and is shown only when `canCreateUpload(ctx)`. The Link tab is shown only when `canCreateLink(ctx)`; if the visitor holds neither permission the page calls the 3.1 forbidden path (`forbidden()` or `notFound()` per HANDOFF). Default the selected tab to the one the visitor may use.
5. **`SermonForm`** (`src/features/sermons/SermonForm.tsx`, client, RHF + `zodResolver(sermonDetailsSchema)`): fields `title` (required), `speaker`, `preached_on` (date input), `series`, `scripture_refs` (comma-separated input mapped to `string[]`, trimmed, empties dropped), `description` (textarea), and a **Publish** control with three states: "Publish now", "Schedule for <datetime-local in the org timezone>", "Save as draft" → `publish_at` = now / the chosen instant converted with `dates.ts` / `null`. Reused by the Link tab and by the edit page (`mode: 'create' | 'edit'`). Inline field errors from Zod; the action's `ActionResult` error shown via `sonner` and, when `error.field` is set, attached to the field.
6. **`LinkPreview`** (`src/features/sermons/LinkPreview.tsx`, client): the Link tab has an `external_url` input; on change (debounced 300 ms) run `parseMediaLink(url, 'web')` in the browser. Render: `ok: false` → "Enter an https:// link" / "That does not look like a link" / "Link too long"; `youtube` → `<iframe src={embedUrl}>` (the `youtube-nocookie.com/embed/<id>` URL from the parser), `title="YouTube preview"`, `allow="encrypted-media; picture-in-picture; fullscreen"`, `referrerPolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin"`, plus helper text "Unlisted videos work; private videos and videos with embedding disabled do not."; `google_drive` → `<iframe src={embedUrl}>` (Drive `/file/d/<id>/preview`) with helper "The file must be shared as 'Anyone with the link'."; `dropbox` with `strategy 'native_stream'` → `<audio controls src={streamUrl}>` (or `<video>` for `.mp4/.m4v`) with helper "Dropbox Basic accounts stop serving links after 20 GB per day."; any kind with `strategy 'open_external'` → "This link will open at the provider; it cannot be played inside the app." with the canonical URL. Never call the provider from the server (no oEmbed in Phase 1; "Re-check link" is step 5.7). Show the detected provider and `canonicalUrl`.
7. **Server Actions** in `src/features/sermons/actions.ts` (`'use server'`; each: `requireOrgMember(slug)` → `requirePerm` → `requireWritable(ctx)` → Zod parse with the `@church/domain` schema → `@church/db` query with the **user** client → `revalidatePath('/o/<slug>/sermons')` and the detail path → `ActionResult` via `ok`/`fail(toActionError)`):
   - `createLinkedSermon(slug, input)`: `requirePerm(ctx, 'sermons.link')`; validate the input with `sermonDetailsSchema` and `sermonLinkSchema` as two separate `safeParse` calls (do not build a merged web-side schema); re-run `parseMediaLink(external_url, 'web')` on the server (never trust the client's parse) and reject `ok: false` with `fail({ key: 'invalid_payload', field: 'external_url', message: 'Enter an https:// link to YouTube, Dropbox, Google Drive or a media file' })` — `invalid_payload` is in the 1.6b catalogue, there is no `invalid_media_link` key; `id = crypto.randomUUID()`; `insertSermonDraft(db, { id, org_id: ctx.org.org_id, media_kind: parsed.kind, external_url: parsed.canonicalUrl, external_id: parsed.externalId ?? null, title, speaker, preached_on, series, scripture_refs, description })`; then `publishSermon(db, id, publish_at)` when the form chose publish/schedule; return `{ id }`; the client redirects to `/o/<slug>/sermons/<id>`. A 42501 from the insert (e.g. `sermons.link` revoked meanwhile) maps to `permission_denied` through `toActionError`.
   - `updateSermon(slug, id, input)`: load the row with `getSermon(db, id)` (404 if missing), `requirePerm(ctx, canEditSermon-key)`, parse `sermonDetailsSchema`, `updateSermonDetails(db, id, patch)`; `publish_at` changes go through `publishSermon(db, id, publishAt | null)` so "Unpublish (back to draft)" is possible. Guard the upload flow of PLAN §6 (insert → upload → update size/mime → set `publish_at`): when `media_kind === 'upload'` and `file_size_bytes === null` (the file never arrived), reject a non-null `publish_at` with `fail({ key: 'invalid_payload', field: 'publish_at', message: 'Finish the upload before publishing' })` — otherwise a broken sermon becomes visible to members and shareable (3.4a/3.4b only checks `publish_at <= now()`). For linked sermons also accept a changed `external_url` (re-parse, update `media_kind`/`external_url`/`external_id` together so `sermons_media_shape` holds); a linked sermon can never become an upload or vice versa — reject with `invalid_payload`.
   - `deleteSermonAction(slug, id)`: `requirePerm(ctx, 'sermons.delete')`; `getSermon(db, id)` → 404 if missing; `deleteSermon(db, id)`; `redirect` to the list with a toast flag. The DB trigger queues the file for deletion; the UI text says "The recording file is removed by the housekeeping job (step 3.6); share links for this sermon stop working immediately."
   - `mintSermonMediaUrl(slug, id)`: `requireOrgMember` only (any member who can see the row may play it — RLS on `storage.objects` decides); `getSermon(db, id)`; if `media_kind !== 'upload'` return `invalid_payload`; mint with `createSignedUrl(createServerSupabase(), 'sermon-media', storage_path, { ttl: SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS })` from `@church/db` `queries/storage.ts` (returns `{ url, expiresAt }`); use 3.1's `getSignedUrl` only if it already returns that shape. Used by the player to re-mint.
8. **Detail / edit page** `/o/[orgSlug]/sermons/[id]`: `getSermon(db, id)` with the user client → `notFound()` when null (RLS hides other orgs' rows and drafts from plain members — a 404, never a 403, so existence is not leaked). Layout: header (title, status badge, kind badge), `SermonPlayer` (item 9), `SermonForm` in edit mode when `canEditSermon(ctx, sermon)` else a read-only details card, a "Share links" card placeholder with the single line "Share links arrive in step 3.4a" (only for `sermons.link`/`sermons.upload` holders — 3.4a replaces this card with `ShareLinksPanel`), and a danger zone with `DeleteSermonButton` (`AlertDialog` confirm naming the consequences) when `canDeleteSermon(ctx)`. For an **upload** row whose `file_size_bytes` is null and `publish_at` is null, show an "Upload incomplete" notice instead of the player (3.3b adds the resume flow here) — do not build resume now; for such rows render the read-only details card WITHOUT the Publish control (the `updateSermon` guard above rejects publishing anyway) and say "Finish the upload before publishing".
9. **`SermonPlayer`** (`src/features/sermons/SermonPlayer.tsx`, client) with props `{ sermon: { id, media_kind, external_url, external_id, mime_type }, media?: { url, expiresAt } , onRemint?: () => Promise<{ url, expiresAt } | null>, variant: 'admin' | 'share' }`. Strategy per `parseMediaLink(external_url, 'web')` for external kinds: `youtube` → `<iframe src={embedUrl}>` (`youtube-nocookie`), `allow="autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture; fullscreen"`, `allowFullScreen`, `referrerPolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin"`, 16:9 box; `google_drive` → `<iframe src={embedUrl}>` (preview); `native_stream` → `<audio controls preload="metadata">` for audio MIME/extensions, `<video controls playsInline>` for video, `src={streamUrl}`; `open_external` → a prominent "Open at <provider>" link (`target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"`). Always render a secondary "Open at provider" link under external players (helps when embeds fail). For `upload`: the server page mints `media` with `createSignedUrl(createServerSupabase(), 'sermon-media', storage_path, { ttl: SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS })` (returns `{ url, expiresAt }`) and passes it; the admin page mints per request (no TanStack cache on web — `SIGNED_URL_CACHE_MS` is the mobile cache window in 4.2); the client renders `<audio>`/`<video>` by `mime_type`; on the element's `error` event, or when the URL is stale at play time — `Date.now() > expiresAt - (SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS * 1000 - SIGNED_URL_CACHE_MS)`, i.e. older than the 50-minute rule of PLAN §6 expressed with the shared constants — call `onRemint()` (the `mintSermonMediaUrl` action, bound in the page) exactly once and reload `src` preserving `currentTime`; if it fails show "Could not load the recording — reload the page." **CSP**: 2.1a's `src/lib/security/csp.ts` (`buildCsp`) emits `media-src 'self' blob: https://<supabase host>` on every non-share page, which blocks the `native_stream` branch (Dropbox `dl.dropboxusercontent.com` and any-https mp3/m4a/mp4/m3u8 — PLAN §6 / DESIGN §7). Widen `media-src` to `'self' blob: https:` in BOTH variants of `buildCsp` (strict and frameable), update `src/lib/security/csp.test.ts` accordingly, and record the deviation from DESIGN §9 ("`media-src` Supabase host") in HANDOFF "Deviations from plan".  Put the strategy dispatch in a pure helper `src/features/sermons/player-strategy.ts` (`playerPlanFor(sermon): { kind: 'iframe', src } | { kind: 'audio' | 'video', src } | { kind: 'external', href, provider } | { kind: 'signed_upload' }`) and unit-test it with the parser's own cases. Step 3.4b imports `SermonPlayer` with `variant: 'share'` and step 4.2 mirrors `player-strategy.ts` on mobile — keep it free of Next-specific imports.
10. **Dates and timezone.** `@church/domain` `dates.ts` has no formatters, so implement `formatInstantInZone(iso, tz)` (for `publish_at`, an instant shown in the org timezone from `getSettings`), `formatDateOnly(isoDate)` (for `preached_on` — a calendar date, no timezone shift) and `zonedLocalToInstant(datetimeLocal, tz)` (the `datetime-local` schedule value → ISO instant in the org timezone, not the browser's) in `src/features/sermons/dates.ts`, using `Intl.DateTimeFormat` or `@date-fns/tz` + `date-fns` referenced as `catalog:` in `apps/web/package.json` (they are already in the pnpm catalog from 1.1 — no new version, no new package); import `isValidTimeZone` from `@church/domain` to guard the zone and fall back to `America/New_York`. Tests: a DST boundary, a year boundary, and an invalid zone falling back.
11. **Tests** (2.1a harness): `perms.test.ts`, `player-strategy.test.ts` (one row per provider/strategy incl. `open_external` and upload), `dates.test.ts`, `actions.test.ts` with a mocked user client — `createLinkedSermon` rejects a non-https URL with `invalid_payload` (`field: 'external_url'`) before touching the DB, passes the parser's `canonicalUrl`/`kind`/`externalId` to `insertSermonDraft`, calls `publishSermon` only when publishing, maps a `42501` PostgREST error to `permission_denied`; `updateSermon` refuses to change an upload into a link (`invalid_payload`) and refuses to publish an upload row whose `file_size_bytes` is null (`invalid_payload`, `field: 'publish_at'`, never calls `publishSermon`); `deleteSermonAction` requires `sermons.delete`. A thin `LinkPreview.test.tsx` (jsdom) asserting the YouTube branch renders an iframe pointing at `youtube-nocookie.com` and the http branch renders the "Enter an https:// link" message.
12. **Copy and help text**: Link tab helper at the top: "Recordings longer than the upload limit (currently <NEXT_PUBLIC_MAX_UPLOAD_MB> MB) are best hosted as an unlisted YouTube video, in Dropbox or in Google Drive and linked here." — read the number from `publicEnv().maxUploadMb` — 2.1a's `publicEnv()` already returns `{ supabaseUrl, supabasePublishableKey, appUrl, maxUploadMb }` (read `src/lib/env.ts`); use it, do not add a second reader.

## Constraints
- Reads and writes use the user-scoped client only; `src/lib/supabase/service.ts` stays un-imported by this feature. No elevated key ever reaches the browser.
- Do not add Zod schemas, media parsing or path builders to `apps/web` — import from `@church/domain`; do not duplicate query code — extend `@church/db/queries/sermons.ts` only additively (a new optional filter parameter) if truly needed, with its own test, and record it in HANDOFF.
- Do not touch `supabase/` (no migrations, `9999_init.sql` may be frozen), `apps/web/vercel.json` or `proxy.ts`. The ONLY header/CSP change allowed is the one in Build 9: widen `media-src` in `src/lib/security/csp.ts` from `'self' blob: https://<supabase host>` to `'self' blob: https:` in both variants and update `csp.test.ts`; leave `next.config.ts`'s `headers()` sources, `frame-src`, `frame-ancestors` and everything else untouched (3.4a/3.4b extends the share-page headers). Do not build uploads (tus, `ResumableUpload`, `tus-js-client` dependency), share links, `/s/*`, `/embed/*`, announcements or bulletins.
- No new runtime dependencies (shadcn-generated components in `src/components/ui/*` are fine; referencing the catalog entries `date-fns` / `@date-fns/tz` as `catalog:` from `apps/web` is allowed — no new version enters the repo). Versions unchanged: Next 16.3, React 19.2.3 exact, TypeScript ~5.9 (never 7), ESLint 9 (never 10), Zod 4.5, supabase-js 2.112.
- Never expose whether a sermon exists to someone who cannot see it: missing or invisible rows → 404.
- Never `supabase db push` / `db reset`. No secrets or model identifiers in files or commits.

- `pnpm turbo lint typecheck test` → green; the new `apps/web` suites (`perms`, `player-strategy`, `dates`, `actions`, `LinkPreview`) run and pass.
